**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading chemical enterprise based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Located at No. 136 Qingchun Road, the company specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance chemical materials and innovative solutions for various industries. With a strong commitment to technological advancement and sustainable development, Runhe Chemical has established itself as a trusted name in the chemical sector, serving both domestic and international markets.

The company’s core expertise lies in the production of advanced chemical materials, including specialty polymers, additives, and functional chemicals tailored for applications in industries such as automotive, electronics, construction, and environmental protection. By leveraging cutting-edge research and development capabilities, Runhe Chemical continuously enhances its product portfolio to meet the evolving demands of global customers.

Runhe Chemical is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and environmental responsibility. The company adheres to strict regulatory compliance and implements advanced manufacturing processes to ensure product excellence. Additionally, its strategic location in Hangzhou—a hub of industrial and technological innovation—provides a competitive edge in logistics, supply chain management, and collaboration with leading research institutions.

With a customer-centric approach and a vision for sustainable growth, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is poised to remain at the forefront of the chemical industry, driving innovation and delivering value to its partners worldwide.
